title_html: TikTok Shop vs. Amazon: Where the Next Incremental Dollar Should Go
description: TikTok Shop vs. Amazon isn't a rivalry question, it's where your next incremental dollar earns more. Real proof for 8- and 9-figure brands deciding the split.
dek: For a brand already clearing real volume on Amazon, TikTok Shop isn't a replacement channel — it's where the next incremental dollar can go further. Here's the honest math on where each platform earns its keep.
author: Jackie He
cta_pre: See where your next dollar goes further on TikTok Shop.
llms_summary: A platform-allocation framework, not a which-is-better comparison, for 8- and 9-figure brands already doing real Amazon volume deciding how much incremental budget to put into TikTok Shop next quarter. Covers where Amazon still wins (mature search intent, fulfillment infrastructure), where TikTok Shop wins on unit economics right now (reallocated ad budget returning 45% GMV growth month over month, GMV Max ROI improving as spend scales, affiliate-driven customer acquisition), and the test-and-scale framework Reach uses with clients to decide the split.
